svg.title: Normal heart rhythm compared with atrial fibrillation
svg.desc: Two example heart tracings, drawn from synthetic data. The normal rhythm shows a small P wave before every beat and the same gap of 0.8 seconds between beats. Atrial fibrillation has no P waves, a wobbly baseline, and gaps between beats that keep changing, from 0.47 to 1.08 seconds.
svg.text: NORMAL RHYTHM · about 75 beats per minute

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

g.text: P wave: the top of the heart fires first

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: ATRIAL FIBRILLATION · about 84 beats per minute

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

g.text: No P waves, just a wobbly baseline
